title: RentGuard Renters Policy Billing Manual — Installment Schedule and Amounts
content:
## Installment schedule by plan

Each term of a RentGuard Renters Policy is billed on the installment schedule of its billing plan:

| Billing plan | Installments per term | Due dates |
|---|---|---|
| Annual plan | 1 | the term effective date |
| Two-pay plan | 2 | the term effective date and six calendar months later |
| Monthly EFT plan | 12 | monthly from the term effective date |
| Monthly card plan | 12 | monthly from the term effective date |

On the monthly plans, a due day that does not exist in a month falls back to the last day of that month.

## Installment amounts

Each later installment is the term premium divided by the number of installments of the plan, rounded half-up to the cent; installment 1 takes the difference, so that the installments add up exactly to the term premium.

## Bill dates

- Installment 1 of a new policy is posted on the bound date.
- Installment 1 of a renewal is posted the tier's renewal billing lead (days before expiration) before the expiring term's expiration date.
- Each later installment is posted 15 days before its due date.

## Midterm re-rating

After a midterm re-rating, the prorated additional or return premium is posted on its own, and the remaining unbilled installments stay as scheduled.

## Installment service charge

The installment service charge is the tier's EFT installment service charge on the monthly EFT plan, the tier's card installment service charge on the monthly card plan, and the tier's two-pay service charge on the second two-pay installment. It is never charged on installment 1, and never on the annual plan.

## Status condition

Installments are billed only while the policy is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal. The status is taken from the policy record of the policy being billed; a cancelled or expired policy is not billed installments.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical)

- **Monthly plan, term premium 243.39.** Each later installment is 243.39 divided by 12, which is 20.2825, rounded half-up to 20.28. Eleven later installments come to 223.08, so installment 1 is 243.39 less 223.08, which is 20.31.
- **Two-pay plan, same term premium.** 243.39 divided by 2 is 121.695, rounded half-up to 121.70 for installment 2; installment 1 is 121.69.
- **Short month.** A monthly term effective on 31 January has an installment due on the last day of February and the next on 31 March.
- **Bill date.** An installment due on 10 April is posted on 26 March, 15 days earlier.
